texts: Keepers warded the wraith back with ground feathers.
Every Keeper considers that the plan was dangerous.

fields.sentence: Keepers warded the wraith back with ground feathers.

q1_issues.issue: "ground" is a descriptive, non-classifying modifier on a plural, so it must distribute over the members via (Implication (PartOf $x sk_feathers_1) (Member $x ground)); (Member sk_feathers_1 ground) instead predicates groundness of the group-as-object, the reading the plural rules explicitly bar.

review.notes: "ward back" is correctly kept as one phrasal-verb symbol with no genus, the episodic bare-plural subject correctly mints a group witness, and the wraith is Theme (displaced, not altered). Whether "ward back" counts as distributive enough to also require a per-member rule on sk_keepers_1 is genuinely unclear.

issues.reason: Categorical statements bars it outright — "a property of a plural's members is never predicated of the group symbol … a bare (Member <group> <prop>) appears only for a property genuinely of the collection itself (its size, its name)" — and being ground holds of each feather, so the descriptive (non-classifying, hence unfused) modifier must go through the distributive rule.

adjudication.defect_summary: Compliant form: replace (Member sk_feathers_1 ground) with the per-member rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_feathers_1) (Member $x ground)) (STV 1.0 0.9), keeping the GroupOf witness, the Instrument link and everything else unchanged.
adjudication.notes: The rest is right: "ward back" kept whole as a phrasal verb with no genus, the episodic bare-plural subject minting a group witness, Theme for the displaced wraith, and Instrument for the means. The reviewer's open question — whether "ward back" is distributive enough to also add a per-member rule on sk_keepers_1 — is a genuine judgment call the instruction set leaves to the distributive/collective test, not a defect.

fields.sentence: Every Keeper considers that the plan was dangerous.

review.notes: Non-factive attitude reified with Experiencer holder and the complement sealed under Theme, the past copular kept inside the seal per surface-mechanical sequence of tense, and only the definite "the plan" typing projected to top level — nothing asserts the plan was dangerous. Universal rule TV and the "every" companion are correct.
